{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sheathe dress in a fluid midi length featuring a subtle sheen, crafted from rich silk blend in #1a233a (deep midnight blue).
Pointed-toe ankle boots with a moderate stiletto heel finished in #000000 (pure black) calfskin.
Delicate drop earrings in #f5f5dc (light champagne gold) and a thin velvet clutch in #2c1810 (espresso).
This ensemble balances the artistic atmosphere of an evening theatre performance while adhering to the social dress code for an 19:00 start. The deep midnight blue sheath reflects the artificial stage lighting elegantly, creating a sleek silhouette that feels both refined and comfortable for sitting through a play. The choice of velvet clutch adds texture without overwhelming, ensuring the focus remains on your presence rather than excessive ornamentation."}
